<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Snowspeeder''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍スノースピーダー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客のどちらかを追加で1名乗せられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ホスの反乱軍基地の技師たちは、エアスピーダーＴ－47を改造し、氷の惑星の極寒の大気の中でも飛行できるようにした。密閉型。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Snowspeeder.

'''Card text:''' May carry one additional pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' Engineers at the Rebel base on Hoth modified the T-47 airspeeder to fly in the frigid atmosphere of the ice planet. Enclosed.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Rebel Snowspeeder|Rebel Snowspeeder]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R104 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections II foil cards, R104. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Rebel-Snowspeeder-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
